schema: FMZ 4054 · Independent four-frame join and USD portfolio ledger

notes.scope: Saved 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-31 23:59:59 hourly Binance chart. Weekly and daily indicators warm up from June 5, 2023. Hourly and four-hour histories start on January 1. Each evaluation uses data complete at the hourly chart close. Jan 2024 daily prices reconcile independently to the 15-minute archives.
notes.fills: Original one-unit default, 100 USD initial equity, 0.01% commission and next-open market orders. The unchanged archive and explicit if form of the peripheral when guards produce identical ledgers. Realized gross uses exit-day FX from the prior Coinbase close and each fee uses its corresponding day's known rate.
notes.margin: The saved Pine v5 clause omits margin parameters. This source-emulator test allows one-unit positions large relative to 100 USD. Replaying the same signals with 100% initial margin admits zero fills on both markets. This is historical execution-model evidence.
notes.drawdown: Workbook drawdown uses settled USD equity. The single settled lot can produce zero realized drawdown even while a position experiences a large interim swing. The ETH short remains open. Ending marked equity, minimum marked equity and marked drawdown are independently reconciled and reported separately.

coverage: Tested · Four completed timeframes and original USD cash model

Pinned hourly source and four causal oscillator streams, including measured prior history. Every signal, position and fill matched the independent check. The no-margin source model closes one BTC lot; the separately guarded full-margin control places no orders.
